summary: Wave 3 backend testing complete — dynamic service categories, vehicle catalogue, recommender, admin CRUD, and enhanced /quote/estimate. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_wave3_catalog.py with 14 test cases, all 14/14 PASSED against localhost:8001. No blockers or minor issues found.
action_items: Legacy job auto-migration (jobs.category='furniture' → 'furniture_delivery' + legacy_category='furniture' on startup) was NOT executed here because it triggers only on backend restart. Main agent can verify by manually inserting a job doc with legacy slug, restarting the backend, and confirming the migration side-effects.
critical_code_review_comments: quote/estimate is a GET endpoint (not POST as some documentation may imply). The Wave 3 request said 'POST /api/quote/estimate' — the actual implementation at server.py:664 is @api.get and works via query params. Tests use GET accordingly.
Login endpoint returns 'access_token' key, not 'token'. Existing test fixtures in /app/backend/tests/test_*.py that read 'token' would break if reused — new fixture handles both.
recommend-vehicle response returns computed_volume_m3=None when neither volume_m3 nor full L×W×H is provided; may be worth defaulting to 0.0 for clients that don't null-guard.

Admin CRUD upsert models allow key to be omitted and auto-derive from name.lower().replace(' ', '_') — this could silently collide with an existing key if the admin doesn't set one; the 400 duplicate-key guard does catch it.
seed_data_creation: Registered one ephemeral TEST customer per pytest module (email prefix TEST_wave3_*). Admin/category/vehicle temp rows are created and DELETED within the same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 3 catalog endpoints, recommender, admin CRUD (both categories & vehicles), and enhanced /quote/estimate (legacy + new slugs) are all green. Legacy job auto-migration on startup was intentionally skipped per the review request. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_wave3_catalog.py for regression. Note fixture pattern: use body.get('access_token') or body.get('token').
